A-1.implementation: Only marginal replay CPU saving fields are emitted; no gross function CPU claim is made.

A-2.implementation: All four controllers and both scenarios complete dual-value and transcript certification before any performance block.

A-3.implementation: All-real total, conditional caller marginals, and interaction residual remain separate.

A-4.implementation: Historical makespan parity is not an adoption gate.

A-5.implementation: Each workerfinished is inserted into the virtual-time heap after that worker's final protocol event and interleaved with peer events.

A-6.implementation: Actual workers scanned are recorded for every tests_finished evaluation.

A-7.implementation: Common-prefix sum is recorded as a mathematical invariant, never as a reorder gate; production reorder, independent digest, and no-op rejection are separate.

A-8.implementation: Unique collection, exact sent index Counter, and slot probes are checked; the no-crash model has no independent retry event surface.

A-9.implementation: First-worker identity alias is primary and all-worker clone is certified before performance.

A-10.implementation: Primary is hot replay; the prior cold label is replaced by an unadoptable pre-touch memory-pressure diagnostic.

A-11.implementation: Manifest load, collection decode/clone, O(1) control construction, transcript, and JSON are outside the timed schedule/event phase.

A-12.implementation: Full measurements use at least 30 fresh paired-block processes with balanced ABBA/BAAB and 95 percent CI.

A-13.implementation: Negative-control CI and order-effect CI must both lie inside the preregistered absolute noise interval.

A-14.implementation: Every K uses the full block rule; block-level slope CI and residual gates suppress the slope field on failure.

A-15.implementation: One-core pinning and whole-run pre/post process evidence exist, but exclusive placement remains unverified and non-authoritative.

A-16.implementation: K=1 and K=2 provenance limitations are fail-closed and explicit; neither historical ordering provenance is falsely marked closed.

A-17.implementation: The 61.3 second hybrid residual is diagnostic only and is never an occupancy denominator.

B-1.implementation: K=1 controller is named groupmap-order conditional and historical K=1 value connection is prohibited.

B-2.implementation: K=2 provenance_closed is false because historical HEAD, ledger, conftest, and ordered worker digest are not jointly available.

B-3.implementation: Login command is parsed as an exact JSON list; nodeids are accepted only inside the stdout section and rejected outside it.

B-4.implementation: Expanded 20.66 MiB JSON is replaced by a self-contained 4.39 MiB deduplicated compact snapshot.

B-5.implementation: Bytecode is disabled before local imports, prepare output is exact-owned, and tracked promotion is documented as a separate mutation.

B-6.implementation: Draft 2020-12 schema validation runs after generation and before promotion; the shared validator exactly recomputes Path A and B leaf adoption, K=2 aggregates, the decision rule, and top-level status.

B-7.implementation: K=2 aggregates require every shard adopted and omit numeric aggregate fields otherwise.

B-8.implementation: Population ID is present on every sample, block, event trace, and pending trace record and is revalidated at promotion.

B-9.implementation: Worker collection decode/clone and control construction occur before the timed schedule/event replay.

B-10.implementation: Isolation evidence wording is whole-run pre/post snapshots only.

B-11.implementation: A preregistered threshold and aggregate CI mechanically produce one selected_next_experiment or inconclusive.

B-12.implementation: A-17 is present and A-8 is accurately marked partial rather than overstating a retry observation.
